beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Egregnosis asks why an available idea may remain invisible to an entire society.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The missing step can be shared recognition rather than another piece of evidence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book proposes a vocabulary for collective attention, expectations, prestige, and memory.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It follows those filters into AI systems that can widen or narrow what becomes thinkable.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers learn to examine how an idea becomes publicly possible without assuming rejection proves genius.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The opening account separates private belief from knowledge of what others will publicly do.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A possibility can remain individually understood while seeming collectively unavailable.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Visible support changes that situation by altering expectations about participation and enforcement.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book uses this distinction to introduce a distributed architecture of collective perception.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It does not require an invisible mind hovering above the people involved.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Prestige, institutional categories, memory, and identity then explain different kinds of selective visibility.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The AI chapters ask what happens when those inherited filters become fluent assistants.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An unusual idea may become clearer while losing the irregularity that made it informative.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book also asks whether its own collective-brain analogy describes a testable mechanism.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Those objections matter because an attractive vocabulary can conceal the very filtering it claims to reveal.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the opening threshold story, then follow how visibility acquires institutional consequences.
